t: This is John Lewis, a British department store chain. The founder, John Lewis, who lived from 1836 to 1928, was a businessman and county councillor who opened the store on Oxford Street, and the chain grew from it. The company dates its founding to 1864. The brand itself was established in 1929 by his son, Spedan Lewis. Today it belongs to the John Lewis Partnership, a company held in trust for its employees, who are its beneficiaries.
